    <script data-navigate-once>
        (function(){
            function applyDark(){
                var m = null;
                try { m = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('theme_mode')); } catch(e) {}
                var dark = m === 'dark' || (m === 'system' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
                if (dark) document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
                else document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            }
            applyDark();
        })();
    </script>

    .quran-book-mini {
        position: relative;
        width: 60px;
        height: 45px;
        perspective: 250px;
    }

    .mini-cover {
        position: absolute;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3396a1 0%, #007c89 100%);
        border-radius: 3px 6px 6px 3px;
        box-shadow:
            0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
            inset 0 0 0 2px #E8B860,
            inset 3px 0 0 0 #c9a456;
    }

    .mini-cover::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
        border: 1.5px solid #E8B860;
        border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .mini-spine {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        width: 6px;
        height: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #007c89 0%, #3396a1 100%);
        border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px;
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #E8B860;
    }

    .mini-pages {
        position: absolute;
        right: 3px;
        top: 3px;
        width: calc(100% - 12px);
        height: calc(100% - 6px);
        transform-origin: left center;
        transform-style: preserve-3d;
    }

    .mini-page {
        position: absolute;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5f0e6 0%, #fff 50%, #f5f0e6 100%);
        border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
        transform-origin: left center;
        box-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .mini-page::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 15%;
        left: 15%;
        right: 15%;
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(
            0deg,
            #ddd,
            #ddd 1px,
            transparent 1px,
            transparent 5px
        );
        background-size: 100% 5px;
        height: 70%;
        opacity: 0.4;
    }

    .mini-page-1 {
        animation: mini-flip 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: 0s;
    }

    .mini-page-2 {
        animation: mini-flip 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: 0.15s;
    }

    .mini-page-3 {
        animation: mini-flip 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: 0.3s;
    }

    @keyframes mini-flip {
        0%, 100% {
            transform: rotateY(0deg);
            z-index: 3;
        }
        50% {
            transform: rotateY(-150deg);
            z-index: 1;
        }
    }
</style>

                 @mousemove="showControls()"
                 @touchstart.passive="showControls()"
                 class="relative overflow-hidden"
                 style="height: calc(100vh - 100px);"
                 :class="[
                     is_full_screen
                         ? '!fixed !w-screen !h-screen !top-0 !left-0 !z-[45] bg-white dark:bg-gray-950'
                         : 'rounded-2xl shadow-sm',
                     !controls_visible ? 'cursor-none' : ''
                 ]"
            >
                
                <div x-show="!$store.listeningStore.background" class="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900"></div>

                
                <div x-show="$store.listeningStore.background"
                     x-cloak
                     :class="$store.listeningStore.background"
                     class="absolute w-full h-full start-0 top-0 z-10"></div>

                
                <div x-show="$store.listeningStore.background" class="absolute bg-gray-900/40 w-full h-full start-0 top-0 z-20"></div>

                
                <div x-ref="loading_box" class="absolute hidden w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-md bg-white/60 dark:bg-gray-900/60 z-50 inset-0">
                    <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">
    <div class="quran-book-mini">
        <div class="mini-cover"></div>
        <div class="mini-pages">
            <div class="mini-page mini-page-1"></div>
            <div class="mini-page mini-page-2"></div>
            <div class="mini-page mini-page-3"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="mini-spine"></div>
    </div>
    <span class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">جاري التحميل ..</span>
</div>

                </div>

                
                
                
                <div x-show="show_reciters"
     x-cloak
     class="fixed inset-0 z-[60]"
     @keydown.escape.window="if(show_reciters) hideRecitersBox()"
>
    
    <div x-show="show_reciters"
         x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-200"
         x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
         x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
         x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-150"
         x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
         x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
         class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-sm"
         @click="hideRecitersBox"
    ></div>

    
    <div x-show="show_reciters"
         x-data="reciters"
         x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-300 transform"
         x-transition:enter-start="translate-x-full rtl:-translate-x-full"
         x-transition:enter-end="translate-x-0"
         x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-200 transform"
         x-transition:leave-start="translate-x-0"
         x-transition:leave-end="translate-x-full rtl:-translate-x-full"
         class="absolute top-0 end-0 h-full w-full sm:w-[420px] bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 flex flex-col shadow-2xl dark:shadow-gray-950/50"
    >
        
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4">
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">اختيار القارئ</h3>
            <button @click="hideRecitersBox"
                    class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors">
                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    <path d="M6.28 5.22a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06L8.94 10l-3.72 3.72a.75.75 0 1 0 1.06 1.06L10 11.06l3.72 3.72a.75.75 0 1 0 1.06-1.06L11.06 10l3.72-3.72a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06-1.06L10 8.94 6.28 5.22Z" />
                </svg>
            </button>
        </div>

        
        <div class="px-5 pb-3">
            <div class="relative">
                <div class="search-input-wrapper relative w-full " @click="event.stopPropagation()">
    <input type="text" class="w-full border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-xl ps-12 py-2.5 pe-6 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 focus:border-primary-500 text-sm transition-all duration-200 placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow focus:shadow-md dark:text-gray-100 !p-3 !ps-28 rounded-xl" x-model.debounce.500ms="query" placeholder="ابحث عن قارئ...">

    <div class="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-400">
        <!-- Loading Spinner -->
        <div data-search-loading class="search-input-spinner hidden">
            <svg class="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-primary-500" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"></circle>
                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
            </svg>
        </div>

        <!-- Search Icon -->
        <div class="search-input-icon">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5 transition-colors duration-200">
                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M9 3.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 0 11 5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-11ZM2 9a7 7 0 1 1 12.452 4.391l3.328 3.329a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-3.329-3.328A7 7 0 0 1 2 9Z" clip-rule="evenodd" />
            </svg>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
                <div class="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 start-2">
                    <div class="relative " x-data="{ open: false }"
     @click.away="open = false" @close.stop="open = false"
>
    <div @click="open = ! open"
         role="button"
         aria-haspopup="true"
         :aria-expanded="open"
         @keydown.escape="open = false"
         tabindex="0"
         @keydown.enter="open = ! open"
         @keydown.space.prevent="open = ! open">
        <button type="button"
                                    class="inline-flex w-full justify-center gap-x-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-200 dark:ring-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors">
                                <span x-text="selected_rawi ? selected_rawi.name : 'الكل'" class="min-w-[3rem]"></span>
                                <svg class="-mr-1 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M5.23 7.21a.75.75 0 0 1 1.06.02L10 11.168l3.71-3.938a.75.75 0 1 1 1.08 1.04l-4.25 4.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.08 0l-4.25-4.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .02-1.06z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>
                                </svg>
                            </button>
    </div>

            <div x-show="open"
             x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-300"
             x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-1"
             x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0"
             x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-200"
             x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0"
             x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-1"
             class="absolute z-50 mt-3 w-24 rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-gray-200/50 dark:shadow-gray-950/50 origin-top-right right-0 "
             style="display: none;"
             role="menu"
             aria-orientation="vertical">
            <div class="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white/95 dark:bg-gray-900/95 backdrop-blur-sm max-h-[28rem] overflow-y-auto nice-scroll p-2 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900">
                <div class="py-1" role="none">
                                <button class="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 block px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-medium text-sm cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 w-full hover:bg-primary-50 dark:hover:bg-primary-900/50 hover:text-primary-700 dark:hover:text-primary-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-primary-100 dark:focus:bg-primary-900/70 focus:text-primary-800 dark:focus:text-primary-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-50 dark:hover:bg-primary-900/30 hover:text-primary-500" @click="selected_rawi = '';" :class="!selected_rawi ? 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/30 text-primary-500 font-semibold' : ''">الكل</button>
                                <template x-for="(rawi,rawiIndex) in rawis" hidden :key="`rawi_drawer_${rawiIndex}`">

'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/30 text-primary-500 font-semibold' : ''"></button>

        </div>

            <div x-show="! $store.listeningStore.selected_language?.id" x-cloak x-transition>

            <div x-data="{ open: false }" class="relative" @click.away="open = false">

            :class="$store.listeningStore.background

    >
        <span class="text-[11px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums"

    </button>

    <div x-show="open" x-cloak
         x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-150"
         x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95 translate-y-1"
         x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100 translate-y-0"
         x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-100"
         x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 scale-100"
         x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 scale-95"
         class="absolute bottom-full mb-2 start-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 py-1.5 min-w-[90px] z-50">
                    <button @click="$store.listeningStore.setPlaybackSpeed(0.5);open=false"
                    class="w-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-center transition-colors"
                    :class="$store.listeningStore.playback_speed === 0.5 ? 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/30 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400 font-bold' : 'text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/50'"
            >

            >

                    <button @click="$store.listeningStore.setPlaybackSpeed(1);open=false"

                initializeIsOpenPropertyForReciters() {
                    const reciters_after_added_is_open = this.reciters.map((reciter, index) => {

                    });

                    this.reciters = reciters_after_added_is_open
                    this.filtered_reciters = reciters_after_added_is_open;
                },
                filterByRawi(reciters) {
                    const isRawiIdMatching = (rawi_id) => +this.selected_rawi.id === +rawi_id;

                    return reciters.map((reciter) => {
                        const clonedReciter = {...reciter};
                        clonedReciter.recitations = reciter.recitations.filter((recitation) => isRawiIdMatching(recitation.rawi_id));
                        return clonedReciter;
                    })
                },
                filterReciters() {
                    const isReciterNameMatching = (reciter) => removeDiacriticsAndVowels(reciter.name.ar).includes(removeDiacriticsAndVowels(this.query));

                    const is_query_valid = this.query && this.query.length > 3;
                    const is_selected_rawi_exists = this.selected_rawi;

                    if (!is_query_valid && !is_selected_rawi_exists) {
                        this.filtered_reciters = this.reciters;
                        return;
                    }

                    if (is_query_valid && is_selected_rawi_exists) {
                        this.filtered_reciters = this.reciters.filter((reciter) => isReciterNameMatching(reciter));
                        this.filtered_reciters = this.filterByRawi(this.filtered_reciters);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (is_query_valid) {
                        this.filtered_reciters = this.reciters.filter((reciter) => isReciterNameMatching(reciter));
                        return;
                    }

                    if (is_selected_rawi_exists) {
                        this.filtered_reciters = this.filterByRawi(this.reciters);
                    }
                },

                show_box_with_details :  Alpine.$persist(false).as('show_box_with_details'),

                async init() {
                   await this.setDefaultSelectedSurah();
                   await this.handleSurahsAndSelectedSurahWhenRecitationUpdated();

                   // Listen for surah selector toggle from control bar
                   document.addEventListener('toggleSurahSelector', () => {
                       this.surah_selector_open = !this.surah_selector_open;
                       if (!this.surah_selector_open) this.query = '';
                   });

                   this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.selected_translation_book', () => this.scheduleFetch());
                    this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.selected_meaning_book', () => this.scheduleFetch());

                    this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.selected_recitation', async () =>  {
                        await this.handleSurahsAndSelectedSurahWhenRecitationUpdated();
                    });

                    window.addEventListener('resize',() => this.setMaxHeight());
                    document.addEventListener('setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper',() => this.setMaxHeight());

                    // Listen for surah navigation from control bar
                    document.addEventListener('loadNextSurah', () => {
                        this.navigateSurah('next');
                    });

                    document.addEventListener('loadPrevSurah', () => {
                        this.navigateSurah('prev');
                    });

                    // Listen for ayah navigation from control bar
                    document.addEventListener('nextAyah', () => {
                        this.navigateAyah('next');
                    });

                    document.addEventListener('prevAyah', () => {
                        this.navigateAyah('prev');
                    });

                    // Listen for external surah navigation
                    document.addEventListener('updateSelectedSurahById', (e) => {
                        if (e.detail?.surah_id) {
                            this.updateSelectedSurah(e.detail.surah_id);
                        }
                    });
                },

               async handleSurahsAndSelectedSurahWhenRecitationUpdated(){
                    this.setShowBoxWithDetails();
                    this.surahs = await this.getSurahsByRecitation();
                    await this.checkIfSelectedSurahExistsInRecitationOrToggleToFirstOne();
                },

               async getSurahsByRecitation() {
                    const url = 'api/qiraat/surahs-by-recitation';

                    try {
                        const response = await http.get(url,{params:{'recitation_id' : this.listeningStore.selected_recitation.id}});
                        return response.data;
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(error);
                        throw error;
                    }
                },

               async checkIfSelectedSurahExistsInRecitationOrToggleToFirstOne() {
                    const is_selected_surah_exists = this.surahs.find((surah) => +surah.id === +this.listeningStore.selected_surah.id);
                    const targetSurahId = is_selected_surah_exists ? this.listeningStore.selected_surah.id : this.surahs[0].id;

                    const surahData = await this.getSurahWithAyahsByRawi(targetSurahId);
                    this.injectMushafFont(surahData.mushaf_css);
                    this.listeningStore.selected_surah = surahData;
                    this.listeningStore.active_ayah = this.listeningStore.selected_surah.ayahs[0];
                    await this.fetchTimingsIfNeeded();
                    this.listeningStore.reInitializeSound();
                },
                setShowBoxWithDetails(){
                    this.show_box_with_details = Boolean(this.listeningStore.getTargetAlpineComponent().config.show_ayahs && (this.listeningStore.selected_translation_book?.id || this.listeningStore.selected_meaning_book?.id));
                },
                scheduleFetch() {
                    clearTimeout(this._fetchTimeout);
                    this._fetchTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
                        this.listeningStore.selected_surah = await this.getSurahWithAyahsByRawi();
                        this.setShowBoxWithDetails();
                    }, 100);
                },
	            setMaxHeight(){
                    const setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper = (elementId) => {
                        const element = document.querySelector(`#${elementId}`);
                        if (element) {
                            element.style.maxHeight = 'none';
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                const top_distance = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;
                                const navbar_height = document.querySelector('#audio-navbar').offsetHeight;
                                const total_distance = Math.round(top_distance + navbar_height);

                                element.style.maxHeight = `calc(max(0px, 100lvh - ${Math.round(total_distance + navbar_height)}px))`;
                            },200);
                        }
                    };

                    setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper('ayahs_wrapper_with_details');
                    setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper('ayahs_wrapper_without_details');
                },

                async setDefaultSelectedSurah() {
                    const default_surah = null;
                    this.listeningStore.selected_surah = await this.getSurahWithAyahsByRawi(default_surah);
                    this.listeningStore.active_ayah  = isObjectNotEmpty(this.listeningStore.active_ayah) ? this.listeningStore.active_ayah : this.listeningStore.selected_surah.ayahs[0];
                    this.$dispatch('selectedSurahUpdated');
                },

                async navigateSurah(direction) {
                    const currentIndex = this.surahs.findIndex(s => +s.id === +this.listeningStore.selected_surah.id);
                    if (currentIndex === -1) return;

                    const nextIndex = direction === 'next' ? currentIndex + 1 : currentIndex - 1;
                    if (nextIndex >= 0 && nextIndex < this.surahs.length) {
                        await this.updateSelectedSurah(this.surahs[nextIndex].id);
                        this.listeningStore.sound.play();
                    }
                },

                navigateAyah(direction) {
                    const store = Alpine.store(this.listeningStore.audio_state_name);
                    if (!store?.switchToAyah) return;

                    const ayah = direction === 'next' ? store.getNextAyah?.() : store.getPrevAyah?.();
                    if (ayah) {
                        store.switchToAyah(ayah.number);
                        // For verse audio, switchToAyah only changes src — need to trigger play.
                        // For timing audio, switchToAyah already seeks+plays via _seekAndPlay.
                        if (this.listeningStore.audio_state_name === 'verseAudioStore') {
                            this.listeningStore.sound.play();
                        }
                    }
                },

                async updateSelectedSurah(surah_id = null , action = null) {
                   const surahData = await this.getSurahWithAyahsByRawi(surah_id);
                   this.injectMushafFont(surahData.mushaf_css);
                   this.listeningStore.selected_surah = surahData;
                   this.listeningStore.active_ayah  = this.listeningStore.selected_surah.ayahs[0];
                   this.$dispatch('selectedSurahUpdated');
                   await this.fetchTimingsIfNeeded();
                   this.listeningStore.reInitializeSound();
                },

                injectMushafFont(css) {
                    if (!css) return;
                    // Inject @font-face into a <style> tag (reuse if exists)
                    let styleEl = document.getElementById('mushaf-font-style');
                    if (!styleEl) {
                        styleEl = document.createElement('style');
                        styleEl.id = 'mushaf-font-style';
                        document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
                    }
                    styleEl.textContent = css;

                    // Extract font-family name from css (e.g. "font-family: Warsh;")
                    const match = css.match(/\.ayah[^{]*\{[^}]*font-family:\s*([^;}\s]+)/);
                    if (match) {
                        this.listeningStore.mushaf_font_family = match[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
                    }
                },

                async fetchTimingsIfNeeded() {
                    const store = Alpine.store('audioWithTimingStore');
                    if (this.listeningStore.audio_state_name !== 'audioWithTimingStore') {
                        store.timings = [];
                        return;
                    }

                    const recitationId = this.listeningStore.selected_recitation.id;
                    const surahId = this.listeningStore.selected_surah.id;

                    try {
                        const response = await http.get(`/api/recitation/${recitationId}/timings/${surahId}`);
                        store.timings = response.data;
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Failed to fetch timings:', error);
                        store.timings = [];
                    }
                },

                async getSurahWithAyahsByRawi(surah_id = null) {
                    const url = `api/qiraat/surah-with-ayahs`;

                    const parameters = {
                        'rawi_id' : Alpine.store('listeningStore').selected_recitation.rawi_id,
                        'surah_id': surah_id || (Alpine.store('listeningStore').selected_surah?.id || null),
	                    'selected_translation_book_id' : Alpine.store('listeningStore').selected_translation_book?.id || null,
	                    'selected_meaning_book_id' : Alpine.store('listeningStore').selected_meaning_book?.id || null,
                    };

                    document.querySelector('[x-ref="loading_box"]')?.classList.remove('hidden');

                    try {
                        const response = await http.get(url,{params:parameters});

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            this.setMaxHeight();
                            document.querySelector('[x-ref="loading_box"]')?.classList.add('hidden');
                        },500);


                        return response.data;
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(error);
                        throw error;
                    }
                },
            }));
        }

        // Register on alpine:init for initial page load
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', registerSurahsDropdownComponent);

        // Also register immediately if Alpine is already initialized (SPA navigation)
        if (window.Alpine) {
            registerSurahsDropdownComponent();
        }
    })();
	</script>

5611","author_id":438,"category_id":5,"version":null,"featured":0,"fundamental":0,"mohaqeq":null,"nasher":"","edition":"","parts":1,"introducer":null,"reviewer":null,"publish_year":null,"origin":null,"tafseer":0,"source":"shamela","source_id":"35421","language_id":1,"book_type_id":null,"has_image":0,"has_text":1,"matching_printed":0,"index":"","extra":null,"created_at":"2019-09-21T19:42:59.000000Z","updated_at":"2020-08-26T16:36:03.000000Z","deleted_at":null}],

                init(){
                    this.restoreMeaningFromUrl();

                    this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.selected_meaning_book', async () =>  {
                        this.$dispatch('close_meanings_modal');
                    });
                },

                restoreMeaningFromUrl(){
                    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                    if (!params.has('meaning')) return;

                    const meaningBookId = +params.get('meaning');
                    const book = this.meanings_books.find(b => +b.id === meaningBookId);
                    if (book) {
                        Alpine.store('listeningStore').selected_meaning_book = book;
                    }
                },
            }));
        }

        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', registerMeaningsBooksComponent);

        // Also register immediately if Alpine is already initialized (SPA navigation)
        if (window.Alpine) {
            registerMeaningsBooksComponent();
        }
    })();

    <script>
        (function() {
            function register_translations_modal() {
                Alpine.data('translations_modal', () => ({
                is_modal_open: false,
                model_key : `translations`,
                init() {
                    Alpine.effect(() => {
                        const watch_selected_surah = this.is_modal_open;
                        this.setMaxHeight();
                    });

                    this.handleOpenAndCloseEventListener(document);

                    document.querySelector(`#${this.model_key}_trigger`)?.addEventListener('click',() => this.is_modal_open = true);

                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',() => {
                        document.querySelector(`#${this.model_key}_trigger`)?.addEventListener('click',() => this.is_modal_open = true);
                    });

                    window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.setMaxHeight());
                },

                handleOpenAndCloseEventListener(element){
                    element.addEventListener(`close_${this.model_key}_modal`, () => {
                        this.is_modal_open = false;
                    });

                    element.addEventListener(`open_${this.model_key}_modal`, () => {
                        this.is_modal_open = true;
                    });
                },

                closeAndDispatchEvent() {
                    this.is_modal_open = false;
                    this.$dispatch(`${this.model_key}_modal_closed`);
                },
                openAndDispatchEvent() {
                    this.is_modal_open = true;
                    this.$dispatch(`${this.model_key}_modal_opened`);
                },
                setMaxHeight(){
                    const content_container = document.querySelector(`#${this.model_key}_content`);
                    if(content_container)
                    {
                        // Get header and footer heights if they exist
                        const modal = content_container.closest('.js-modal-container');
                        const header = modal?.querySelector('.js-modal-header');
                        const footer = document.querySelector(`#${this.model_key}_footer`);

                        const headerHeight = header?.offsetHeight || 0;
                        const footerHeight = footer?.offsetHeight || 0;
                        const padding = window.innerWidth > 640 ? 80 : 0; // account for modal padding on desktop

                        // Calculate available height (viewport - header - footer - padding)
                        const maxHeight = window.innerHeight - headerHeight - footerHeight - padding;
                        content_container.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(maxHeight, 200)}px`;
                    }
                },
            }));
            }

            // Register on alpine:init for initial page load
            document.addEventListener('alpine:init', register_translations_modal);

            // Also register immediately if Alpine is already initialized (SPA navigation)
            if (window.Alpine) {
                register_translations_modal();
            }
        })();
    </script>

        <script>
            (function() {
                function registerListeningComponent() {
                    Alpine.data('listening', () => ({
                    show_reciters: false,
                    is_full_screen: false,
                    controls_visible: true,
                    _hideControlsTimer: null,

                    init() {
                        this.$watch('is_full_screen',() => {
                            this.setRootWrapperHeight()
                            this.$dispatch('setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper');
                        });

                        this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.background',() => {
                            this.setRootWrapperHeight()
                            this.$dispatch('setMaxHeightForAyahsWrapper');
                        });

                        // Cinema mode: auto-hide controls when playing
                        this.$watch('$store.listeningStore.is_audio_playing', (playing) => {
                            if (playing) {
                                this.startHideTimer();
                            } else {
                                this.clearHideTimer();
                                this.controls_visible = true;
                            }
                        });

                        this.setRootWrapperHeight();

                        Alpine.nextTick(() => {
                            this.setRootWrapperHeight();
                        });

                        window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.setRootWrapperHeight());

                        // iOS Safari: visualViewport resize fires when toolbar shows/hides
                        if (window.visualViewport) {
                            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', () => this.setRootWrapperHeight());
                        }

                        document.addEventListener('hideRecitersBox', () => {
                            this.hideRecitersBox();
                        });

                        // Listen for auto-next surah
                        document.addEventListener('loadNextSurah', () => {
                            this.loadNextSurah();
                        });

                        // Sync state when user exits fullscreen via Escape key
                        document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
                            if (!document.fullscreenElement && this.is_full_screen) {
                                this.is_full_screen = false;
                            }
                        });
                    },
                    showControls() {
                        this.controls_visible = true;
                        if (Alpine.store('listeningStore').is_audio_playing) {
                            this.startHideTimer();
                        }
                    },
                    startHideTimer() {
                        this.clearHideTimer();
                        this._hideControlsTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                            this.controls_visible = false;
                        }, 3000);
                    },
                    clearHideTimer() {
                        if (this._hideControlsTimer) {
                            clearTimeout(this._hideControlsTimer);
                            this._hideControlsTimer = null;
                        }
                    },
                    async makeFullScreen() {
                        if (!this.is_full_screen) {
                            // Fullscreen the documentElement so teleported modals (on <body>) remain visible
                            await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
                            this.is_full_screen = true;
                        } else {
                            await document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
                            this.is_full_screen = false;
                        }
                    },
                    showRecitersBox() {
                        this.show_reciters = true;
                    },
                    hideRecitersBox() {
                        this.show_reciters = false;
                    },
                    async loadNextSurah() {
                        const store = Alpine.store('listeningStore');
                        const currentSurahId = store.selected_surah?.id;
                        if (!currentSurahId) return;

                        // Dispatch event to surahs_dropdown to load next surah
                        const nextSurahId = currentSurahId + 1;
                        if (nextSurahId <= 114) {
                            this.$dispatch('updateSelectedSurahById', { surah_id: nextSurahId });
                        }
                    },
                    setRootWrapperHeight(){
                        const root_wrapper = this.$refs.root_wrapper;
                        if (this.is_full_screen) {
                            root_wrapper.style.height = '100vh';
                        } else {
                            const top_distance = root_wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().top + 24;
                            const viewportHeight = window.visualViewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight;
                            root_wrapper.style.height = `${viewportHeight - top_distance}px`;
                        }
                    }
                }));
            }

            // Register on alpine:init for initial page load
            document.addEventListener('alpine:init', registerListeningComponent);

            // Also register immediately if Alpine is already initialized (SPA navigation)
            if (window.Alpine) {
                registerListeningComponent();
            }
        })();
        </script>
    </body>
